items.title: Aptiv (APTV) Leaves The FTSE All World Index, Is It Still 35% Undervalued?
items.summary: Aptiv (APTV) has come under pressure after being removed from the FTSE All-World Index in US dollars, a shift that coincides with weak earnings expectations and cautious analyst sentiment around the stock.
